Every gate blocker names the internal switch to turn off first: gates.mjs --switch <name>=off sets ALIASMODE_SWITCHES_OFF=<name>, which the app reads with switchOff() (fingerprint.ts). hints: the first entry whose regex matches a Gate A probe id or a Gate B signal names the switch; Gate C sites name theirs in sites.json switch_hint. 'none' = no switch covers it yet: bisect by engine build (gates on the released build against the candidate). Add a switch here when the app or an engine gains one.
